description: The LLM outputs only an evaluation result and references to existing evidence. The Host binds the result to a fixed observation before submission. Identity, version, protocol, time, and target fields are not accepted.

evidence_refs.description: At least one existing evidence.ref from this observation that supports the decision. Do not cite material outside the observation or invent evidence.

grade.description: Again: an actual recall attempt failed. Hard: successful recall with clear evidence of difficulty. Good: successful recall with evidence of ordinary effort. Easy: successful recall with evidence of ease. Use unscorable when recall succeeded but difficulty is unknown; do not default to Good.

rationale.description: Briefly state the decisive evidence for the judgment without revealing hidden reasoning, full source text, or unrelated private information.

reason_code.description: The most direct reason scoring is blocked: no_recall means no actual recall; target_mismatch means the target does not match; insufficient_evidence means evidence is inadequate; answer_exposed means the answer was visible; exposure_unknown means exposure cannot be determined; difficulty_unknown means successful recall with unknown difficulty; interrupted means the expression was interrupted; evaluation_failed means no reliable judgment could be reached.

status.description: graded means the result can be scored and includes grade; unscorable means it cannot be scored and includes reason_code.
